mapper.insert: insert into warehouse(name, staff_id, del_flag, create_by, remark, create_time) values (#{name}, #{staffId}, 0, #{createBy}, #{remark}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select * from warehouse where id = #{id} and del_flag = 0
select * from warehouse where name = #{name} and del_flag = 0
select * from warehouse where del_flag = 0 order by create_time desc

select w.*, s.name as staff_name from warehouse w left join staff s on w.staff_id = s.id where w.del_flag = 0
and w.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
order by w.create_time desc
